title.en: RTA / RTP: rapid single-wafer control of thermal processing

subtitle.zh: 灯加热、温度闭环与扩散控制
subtitle.en: Lamp heating, closed-loop temperature control and diffusion control

body.zh: RTP是快速热处理平台；RTA是该平台执行退火任务时的常用称呼。
body.en: RTP is a rapid thermal processing platform; RTA is the common term when this platform Performs an annealing task.

body.zh: RTP快速热处理平台RTA退火执行方式
body.en: RTP Rapid thermal processing platform RTA annealing Execution mode

body.zh: 高温计Pyrometer / Emissometer（非接触测温）

body.en: Load one wafer into the chamber

body.zh: 峰值温度决定扩散深度与反应程度
body.en: Peak temperature Determines diffusion depth and Reaction extent

body.zh: Ramp Rate影响缺陷与热应力
body.en: Ramp Rate Affects defects and Thermal stress

body.zh: Dwell Time控制反应与扩散时间
body.en: Dwell Time Controls reaction and Diffusion time

body.zh: 发射率校正与片内均匀性决定测量准确与温度一致性
body.en: Emissivity correction and Within-wafer uniformity Determine measurement accuracy and Temperature consistency

body.zh: 较低总热预算/扩散控制更好
body.en: Lower total thermal budget / Better diffusion control

body.zh: 温度测量、表面吸收、背面状态与 Pattern Loading更敏感
body.en: Greater sensitivity to temperature measurement, surface absorption, Backside condition and Pattern Loading

body.zh: 量测反馈：多点温度 · Rs Map · 薄膜相 · 接触电阻
body.en: Metrology feedback: multipoint temperature · Rs Map · film phase · contact resistance

body.zh: 多点高温计（多点非接触）
薄膜相（XRD）相峰与结构强度2θ
body.en: Film phase (XRD) Phase peaks and structure Intensity 2θ

body.zh: Kelvin / 接触电阻（接触品质）
闭环调整温度与时间窗口
body.en: Closed-loop adjustment of temperature and time windows

body.zh: 典型应用（RTA为RTP的一种执行）
body.en: Typical applications (RTA is one mode of RTP)

body.zh: RTP也可执行氧化、氮化等处理，并非只用于退火；具体窗口依材料与整合路线而变。
body.en: RTP can also perform oxidation and nitridation; it is not limited to annealing. Actual windows depend on materials and the integration route.
